preconditions.description: The length of the string S is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the string S are one of 'a', 'b', or 'c'.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer.
The output is within the range of a 32-bit signed integer modulo 10^9 + 7.
